subject: MAP: Legal ownership & turnaround (MSA/DPA/SLA) — proposed responsibilities
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smythe <jane.smythe@acmetech.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Legal ownership & turnaround (MSA/DPA/SLA) — proposed responsibilities

Hi Jane — thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Per our conversation I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) and a SOC2 snapshot for your legal team to review. Below is a concise proposal for the "Legal redlines" MAP milestone so we have clear owners and turnaround expectations. Please confirm or propose edits and we can update the single-source MAP file.

Proposed MAP milestone: Legal redlines (MSA / DPA / SLA)
- Target close date: 2026-08-07
- Owners:
  • MSA: ACME Legal to provide initial redlines (owner: ACME). Redwood Legal to perform first-pass responses and reconciling edits.
  • DPA: ACME to provide their DPA (if you have a preferred template). Redwood will propose privacy-specific changes (where cross-border data, subprocessors, or retention need clarification).
  • SLA (uptime / incident handling / credits): Redwood to own SLA language that references our runtime commitments; ACME can propose edits relating to business-impact definitions.
- Turnaround (proposed):
  • Initial round (minor edits / cleanup): 2 business days per side
  • Substantive redlines (material changes to terms or data/privacy): 3–5 business days per side depending on exec/legal review requirements
- Acceptance criteria:
  • Agreed text in a single tracked-changes document; signatures or DocuSign step after legal alignment; no open legal comments older than 72 hours in the final week before target close date.
- Dependencies / blockers:
  • Procurement: PO or SOW approval (accounting/procurement cadence) — expected from ACME by 2026-07-27
  • Evidence: SOC2 snapshot (attached) and additional audit artifacts if required
  • IP addendum / export controls: will be handled as a separate appendix if ACME requests it

Next steps I propose:
1) If ACME agrees with ownership/timelines above, ACME legal sends MSA redlines by 2026-07-20.
2) Redwood Legal (Marcus) does first-pass within the agreed turnaround.
3) We iterate in the MAP file; once legal aligns we move to DocuSign.

Files attached: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP table with milestone rows), SOC2_snapshot.pdf

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP after your confirmation.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0186

From: Jane Smythe <jane.smythe@acmetech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acmetech.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Legal ownership & turnaround (MSA/DPA/SLA) — proposed responsibilities

Dylan — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few quick points from ACME Legal: 

- Ownership: ACME Legal is happy to take the lead on the initial MSA redlines (we find it speeds negotiation if we start from our template). We will aim to send those redlines to Redwood by 2026-07-20 as you suggested.
- DPA: We will attach our DPA template. We prefer that Redwood provides a single consolidated set of privacy edits back (so we don’t have parallel, divergent documents).
- SLA: We expect Redwood to own the operational SLA language (uptime, incident response, credit calculation). If Redwood’s SLA references internal telemetry/metrics, please make the metric definitions explicit.
- Turnaround: ACME can commit to 3 business days for minor rounds and 5 business days for substantive rounds (we have a small legal bench and some team members are out late July / early Aug).
- Format: please provide redlines in Word or Google Docs with tracked changes; a PDF summary is helpful but not sufficient for edits.

We will also need the contact for Redwood legal — please copy counsel on the thread so we have a direct line. Once we receive your counsel’s contact and the MAP updated with owners/timelines, I’ll route for priority review and confirm the MSA redline send date.

Best,
Jane
Jane Smythe
Head of Commercial Contracts | ACME Tech
jane.smythe@acmetech.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smythe <jane.smythe@acmetech.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Legal ownership & turnaround (MSA/DPA/SLA) — proposed responsibilities

Thanks Jane — appreciate the quick read. Dylan: looping in Marcus Lin (Redwood Legal) as requested. Marcus, quick alignment items for your awareness and confirmation:

- Redwood will accept ACME taking the first-pass MSA redlines. Redwood Legal will perform a tracked-changes response and propose language for SLA and platform-specific items.
- Proposed Redwood turnarounds (we’d like to tighten these slightly but stay realistic): 2 business days for minor/redline rounds; up to 3 business days for substantive DPA or SLA edits. If an edit triggers executive review (e.g., indemnity, export controls), we should flag those as "extended review" and call out an explicit owner/estimated time in the MAP.
- We’ve attached a SOC2 snapshot in case ACME asks for specific control references during privacy review.

Marcus — can you confirm you / your team can commit to the above SLAs and provide a preferred email alias for direct exchange with ACME Legal?

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Smythe <jane.smythe@acmetech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Legal ownership & turnaround (MSA/DPA/SLA) — proposed responsibilities

Evelyn / team — confirmed. Redwood Legal will do the following: 

- MSA: We will perform a tracked-changes pass within 3 business days of receiving ACME’s redlines. For straightforward edits we will aim for 2 business days; I’m allocating a small burst capacity to prioritize this deal given the timeline.
- DPA: Redwood will review and return consolidated privacy edits within 4 business days for substantive items. If ACME’s DPA introduces unusual data-transfer or subprocessor obligations, we’ll flag those and propose a short appendix.
- SLA: Redwood will own SLA language. If ACME proposes changes that require changes to our runtime commitments, we will escalate to Product Ops — those items may require up to 5 business days to resolve.

Please use my email alias for legal exchanges: contracts-legal@redwood.com (I’ll monitor it and ensure we meet the stated turnarounds). If ACME would prefer a shared Google Doc for redlines, that works for us; otherwise please attach a Word doc.

— Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
contracts-legal@redwood.com

From: Jane Smythe <jane.smythe@acmetech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acmetech.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Legal ownership & turnaround (MSA/DPA/SLA) — proposed responsibilities

Perfect — thanks Marcus and team. We will:
1) Send ACME’s MSA redlines (Word tracked changes) by COB 2026-07-20.
2) Attach ACME’s DPA in the same package and indicate any early privacy asks.
3) Request that Redwood return consolidated edits to contracts-legal@redwood.com using tracked changes in Word.

One ask from procurement: can we agree today on the MAP milestone row format for legal so procurement can map it to our PO timing? Please include a single-line milestone in the MAP file like: 

"Legal redlines complete — owner: ACME / Redwood (see role split) — turnaround per-round: 3 business days — target: 2026-08-07"

Once we have that in the MAP I’ll mark it as a dependency for procurement and confirm the PO timeline. After legal alignment we’ll be ready to proceed to signature via DocuSign.

Thank you all — look forward to the redlines on the 20th.

Jane
